articles.summary: In a press release dated April 29, 2021, we reported positive topline Phase I results in our innovative hematology program. This study, the first to evaluate PLX-R18 in humans, demonstrated that PLX-R18 had the potential to stimulate the bone marrow to generate all three blood cell lines – a meaningful advantage over other existing and proposed treatments.
articles.title: Positive Topline Phase I Results – Hematology Program
